sourceKind: observed sample, some environments may be mixed
details: INT.GG Meta Score includes observed player performance and popularity, not a controlled build-level damage/recoil measurement. Scores can change and are only used to flag outdated community tiers, not shown as a guaranteed DPS rank.
policy: For MP and Rapid only: If Season-5 SMG Meta Score is known and under 45, do not recommend it. REDSEC should use separate data. Score is a reliability gate, not a claim that the associated loadout performs at this score.
lmgPolicy: Multiplayer and Rapid LMGs use newer observed Season 5 scores before older guide S/A tiers. Scores refer to weapons, not builds, and Rapid is not independently measured. REDSEC uses separate source tiers.
